title: Development of dEep EndometrioSis Following Acute haemoPerITonEum
official: Development of dEep EndometrioSis Following Acute haemoPerITonEum
summary: This study investigates whether acute pelvic pain with haemoperitoneum is associated with an increased risk of developing deep pelvic endometriosis, compared with acute pelvic pain without haemoperitoneum. Women aged 18-50 who attended the Obstetric-Gynecological Emergency Department for acute pelvic pain between January 2020 and December 2024 will be invited to a single follow-up visit, including a transvaginal ultrasound and validated questionnaires.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women aged 18-50 years
* Female sex
* Attendance at the Obstetric-Gynecological Emergency Department (Clinica Mangiagalli) for acute pelvic pain
* For cases: documented haemoperitoneum without a previous diagnosis of endometriosis
* For controls: no documented haemoperitoneum without a previous diagnosis of endometriosis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous hysterectomy and/or oophorectomy
* Established menopause
